create.name: Maureen J. St. Germain
create.bio:
Maureen J. St. Germain is an American teacher of sacred geometry, MerKaBa meditation and the Akashic Records, known to her students as the Practical Mystic. She began leading Flower of Life workshops in 1995, and over the years has taught in person in some two dozen countries, including programmes at Kripalu and Omega, and led group pilgrimages to sites in Egypt, Scotland, France and Spain. In 1994 she set up the company that grew into the St. Germain Mystery School, and she also founded Akashic Records International, a network of guides trained and certified in her method.

Her central theme is a clear, everyday link with the Higher Self, which she treats as the ground for every other practice. Students learn the classic seventeen-breath MerKaBa meditation, ways of opening their own Akashic Records, and her approach to living from a fifth-dimensional outlook of love rather than fear. She has written several books with Bear & Company, among them Waking Up in 5D, Beyond the Flower of Life and Opening the Akashic Records, and records guided meditations for her free Illuminate app. Her school runs recorded courses, a low-cost monthly membership with live calls, and a year-long advanced programme.

books.title: Waking Up in 5D: A Practical Guide to Multidimensional Transformation
books.author: Maureen J. St. Germain
books.description: St. Germain's guide to moving from a fear-based outlook to what she calls fifth-dimensional living. It sets out daily practices for strengthening the Higher Self connection and noticing which state of awareness you are in.

books.title: Beyond the Flower of Life: Advanced MerKaBa Teachings, Sacred Geometry, and the Opening of the Heart
books.author: Maureen J. St. Germain
books.description: A book on the MerKaBa meditation that she has taught since the 1990s, with background in sacred geometry. It explains the breath sequence step by step and adds her later material on heart-centred practice.

books.title: Opening the Akashic Records: Meet Your Record Keepers and Discover Your Soul's Purpose
books.author: Maureen J. St. Germain
books.description: An introduction to the Akashic Records and her prayer-based method for reading your own. It covers how to frame questions and what to expect from the record keepers.

books.title: Mastering Your 5D Self: Tools to Create a New Reality
books.author: Maureen J. St. Germain
books.description: The follow-up to Waking Up in 5D, with further exercises for staying centred in a loving, higher state of awareness. It focuses on practical tools for daily choices.

books.title: Living Your Best 5D Life: Timeless Tools to Achieve and Maintain Your New Reality
books.author: Maureen J. St. Germain
books.description: The third book in her 5D series, gathering practices for keeping a fifth-dimensional outlook over the long term. It draws on her meditations and Higher Self work.

courses.title: The Way of the Akashic Guide (certification)
courses.description: A certification programme for reading the Akashic Records for other people, in her lineage. It opens with a four-day live intensive, followed by six weeks of follow-up and six months of support.

courses.title: MerKaBa Classic - Full Digital Workshop
courses.description: Her complete recorded workshop on the classic seventeen-breath MerKaBa meditation. It teaches the visualisation and breathing sequence in full, with the background she gives it.

courses.title: The MerKaBa Classic: Condensed Digital Workshop
courses.description: A shorter video version of her MerKaBa teaching, covering how to activate and programme the meditation. It also includes her instructions for linking with the Higher Self.

courses.title: Connecting with Your Higher Self
courses.description: A self-paced online course of twelve short lessons on what she means by the Higher Self. It walks through building trust in that inner guidance and three agreements she uses for the connection.

courses.title: Sacred Geometry: The Codes of Creation
courses.description: A recorded series of about eight and a half hours on sacred geometry, phi, the golden spiral and why she places the MerKaBa at the centre of her teaching. It also covers the divine feminine and Mary Magdalene symbolism.

courses.title: Ascension Portal membership
courses.description: Her membership with a live monthly Zoom call and Q&A, plus monthly lessons that follow the chapters of Waking Up in 5D. Members also receive one of her recorded meditations each month.
courses.price: $11 USD per month or $99 USD per year

courses.title: Timeline Jumping
courses.description: A recorded course built around a short daily practice for choosing a different direction in life. It is meant to take about fifteen minutes a day.

courses.title: Discovery Dragon Energy
courses.description: A short recorded course with a guided meditation for meeting and naming what she calls your dragons, as helpers for clarity and getting things done.

courses.title: Ascension Institute (year-long advanced training)
courses.description: Her year-long group coaching programme for committed students. Entry is by application and an interview with her; the application fee is listed separately from the programme.
